description: Unified Admin UI + IAM + JWT + Basic Auth + API Keys for multi-tenant Dynamic CRUD API platforms. v2.1.8 lets a workspace link its own DbManagement account (an external database-provisioning product) instead of only the platform's shared one — once linked it's always preferred and isn't capped by the platform's per-tenant managed-database limit, and the workspace can list and register databases that account already has. Adds IManagedDatabaseCatalog (list/connection/webhook-registration, alongside the existing IManagedDatabaseProvisioner) for the host to implement; async/queued provisioning is tracked via a new per-database state, resolved by a DbManagement webhook rather than polled. v2.1.7 fixes a regression in 2.1.6: a role a platform admin creates directly for a tenant stopped applying from a LoginLink sign-in unless the workspace had own-roles switched on — that policy only ever governed self-service role creation, never using a role that already exists. v2.1.6 fixes LoginLink sign-ins never getting a built-in role's permissions (Reader/Writer/Editor/Database admin) applied — the lookup only ever matched a tenant's own custom roles, so a built-in role named on a token was silently ignored; now resolved the same tested way the admin console and key-assignment paths already use, never granting Owner. v2.1.5 fixes the tenant console's Users page showing only a raw LoginLink subject id forever — the person's email, already resolved on every LoginLink data-API call, now reaches the Users row the same way, backfilling an existing person's record the next time they're seen without ever overwriting an email or display name already set. v2.1.4 adds a third "who may sign in" choice for a tenant's console: auto-approve LoginLink tenant admins, between the existing approve-everyone and open-to-anyone options — a LoginLink account whose user_kind is tenant_admin is let straight in, no manual approval needed. v2.1.3 makes the platform's own public address a Host Setting (host.public_base_url) instead of only an environment variable — editable from Host Settings or captured during first-run setup, with the old Public:BaseUrl env var still honored as a fallback. v2.1.2 fixes v2.1.0/2.1.1's API-identifier default (now the deployment's own Public:BaseUrl, not the current request's host) and makes a failed API registration show on the Access page instead of failing silently. v2.1.1 adds a "Register as API" button to the Tenant console's Access page, for v2.1.0's registered-API retry endpoint (POST /access/loginlink/apis/register) — previously reachable only directly, with no console UI for it. v2.1.0 makes CrudApi a registered API in LoginLink (ADR 2026-10-17-crudapi-as-loginlink-api) so a second app, not just CrudAdmin's own, can call the data API as its signed-in users, resolved by organisation (new Host Setting loginlink.api_identifier; a workspace now connects to only its own LoginLink organisation). Also fixes the bearer-token "email" claim, absent by LoginLink design — now fetched from /userinfo. v2.0.1 adds "Unregister" to a database's Actions menu — removes it from the workspace's own registry (CORS, row policies, rate limits, cached config) without touching the underlying database itself. v2.0.0 is a platform-scale admin console rewrite: a unified Access model, a two-tier Developer API key system, LoginLink tenant self-service login, Managed Database provisioning, and a consolidated Storage & data page replace the old separate pages. Breaking: /admin/backup, /admin/basicauth, /admin/cors, /admin/databases, /admin/issuancekeys, /admin/jwtsessions, /admin/migratemysql, /admin/policies, /admin/provisioningkeys, /admin/roles, /admin/tenantsessions and /admin/users are removed — see Access model, Storage & data, and Developer API.
